title: Two Sum
problem_summary: Find two indices such that their values add up to the target.

brute_force.idea: Try all possible pairs using nested loops

optimized.idea: Use a hashmap to store visited numbers

hints: What happens if you check every possible pair of numbers?
Is there a way to remember numbers you've already seen?
How fast can you check if a number exists using a hashmap?
Using a hashmap can reduce repeated comparisons.
